title: Make uncertainty specific to its source claim
basis: LIVE student counterfactual; coordinator pure-function reproduction
problem: An unrelated mixed skills line can make a completed project become review-required. Removing Python from that skills line changes the classification while the project and vacancy stay identical.
action: Scope pending, negated and expired wording to the relevant skill or achievement. Preserve complete source passages and explain the precise conflict.
acceptance: The paired fictional inputs retain the same finding for the completed Python project; SQL coursework remains qualified. Add distinct cases for supported versus led, unfinished certificates and unrelated negation.

title: Separate job conditions from achievement evidence
basis: LIVE student check; coordinator reproduction
problem: Graduation and application dates receive team-size/budget guidance. A sponsorship restriction is paired with an unrelated sentence about not leading a team.
action: Classify deadlines, graduation timing, languages, professional experience and sponsorship statements separately. Extract quoted requirements for explicit manual review; do not infer legal eligibility or advise inventing CV achievements.
acceptance: An application closing date becomes a dated action or an explicit unknown. Sponsorship text has no unrelated CV evidence. Coursework is never promoted to professional-experience satisfaction.

title: Provide a usable support and erasure route
effort: 1 day setup, then ongoing service; estimate
basis: LIVE Contact/Privacy; SOURCE absence of record-erasure action
problem: Privacy directs account erasure to support, while Contact says direct support details are unavailable. The pilot displays a separate address whose delivery has not been established.
action: Publish one monitored support/data-request destination, verify its receipt, explain original/check/claim/packet/run retention, and provide a reviewed owner-verification and completion process.
acceptance: A fictional data request gets an acknowledgement and documented fulfillment. Scope includes cloud records and artifacts; already downloaded files and required exceptions are explained. Never request passwords or a full CV by ordinary support email.

title: Show today's capabilities before sign-in
basis: LIVE homepage; same-day release configuration
problem: Search and replies appear as loop stages, with a setup caveat. Customers cannot see a clear current availability summary before committing to setup.
action: Show available user-added-vacancy preparation, unavailable external discovery/inbox lanes, user-triggered runs and beta limits together. Separate operator setup from customer consent.
acceptance: An unfamiliar visitor can correctly explain what works now and what needs setup. No unavailable connection resembles a completed search with zero results.

title: Enable a useful, permitted role-discovery lane
effort: 3–5 engineering days plus account/source access, estimate
basis: RELEASE unavailable sources; SOURCE source adapters
problem: Customers must find and copy vacancies themselves. No current discovery was demonstrated by the audits; the cloud search and employer sources require configuration.
action: Start with permitted employer feeds or an explicitly maintained source-backed shortlist. Enable bounded search only after provider setup within the shared US$50 usage ceiling. Record employer, location, complete posting, source link and checked time.
acceptance: Each target audience finds useful non-fictional roles from a permitted source. Incomplete descriptions are held for confirmation; unavailable feeds and uncertain closure are clearly identified. Do not scrape logged-in job boards or count snippets as verified vacancies.

title: Guide the first reusable career record
basis: SOURCE claim editor and defaults; inferred setup burden
problem: The reusable record requires many fields and individually cleared suggestions before the first packet. A professional starts with student/one-page defaults unless they change them.
action: Carry the chosen audience into an explicit preset. Start with three representative facts, show contribution/context/result examples, prefill literal source data and progressively reveal advanced preferences. Keep confirmation and sharing separate.
acceptance: A first-time student and switcher can prepare their first record without assistance in a timed test. They understand what is stored and shared. Prefill never silently attests a fact or invents metrics.

title: Connect check, career record and tracking
basis: SOURCE separate stores and handoffs
problem: A successful guest check does not carry its reviewed evidence and vacancy directly into the loop. Legacy workspace tracking and loop opportunities are separate concepts.
action: Offer an explicit, previewed 'Continue this application in Job Loop' handoff. Reuse the original source, full vacancy and prior review while requesting any new cloud-saving and fact-sharing choices. Present one linked application timeline.
acceptance: One fictional vacancy moves from check to a reusable record and approved packet without retyping or a duplicate tracker entry. Account switches and changed facts still fence old data and approvals.

title: Prevent accidental loss of an unsaved check
basis: Independent LIVE student and mobile journeys
problem: Leaving a populated check for a built-in page such as Privacy and returning resets the workflow to an empty first step. The warning focuses on refresh and closing rather than in-app navigation.
action: Provide a navigation warning with Stay/Discard choices and an optional clearly explained device-only recovery choice. Make reading privacy/help safe without silently persisting a CV.
acceptance: Step six → Privacy → Back preserves the reviewed draft or shows an explicit loss decision. Default persistence and retention remain transparent; close, clear and recovery expiry behave as stated.

title: Preview the actual document and resolve page holds
basis: LIVE plain-text guest preview; SOURCE cloud page holds
problem: Customers approve text without seeing the final rendered layout. The cloud correctly holds page overflow, but asks for record edits and another run rather than helping the user choose what to shorten.
action: Show the real rendered page preview and page count, source-preserving bullet inclusion controls and excess-content guidance before approval. Keep chronology, evidence context and factual changes visible.
acceptance: A representative MBA one-page CV and a senior two-page CV preview match their downloaded artifacts. No text is silently dropped or font reduced to unreadability. A held output has an understandable recovery path.

title: Support Arabic names without blocking every format
basis: SOURCE font cmap inspection and rendering gates, not live PDF execution
problem: The shared PDF font has no glyphs for inspected Arabic characters. An Arabic name in an English CV can fail guest PDF export and hold the entire cloud packet, including otherwise renderable formats.
action: Add a licensed font/shaping path for supported bilingual names, or separate safe format-specific readiness with a clear fallback. Keep English-analysis scope explicit unless Arabic evidence analysis is actually built.
acceptance: Test Arabic names, mixed direction text and supported English content in real PDF/DOCX/TXT outputs. No invisible glyphs, incorrect shaping or lost facts. Preview and downloads make unsupported cases explicit.

title: Make discretion actionable
basis: SOURCE reminder-only discreetSearch behavior
problem: Discreet search is currently a reminder, not a current-employer/contact blocking rule. A busy employee still bears the checking burden.
action: Explain the reminder precisely. Add explicit employer/domain exclusions, confidential-figure review and named-recipient warnings where relevant. Let users inspect the exact externally shareable wording.
acceptance: A configured excluded employer/domain is flagged or blocked in the tested relevant lane; support facts do not become leadership; confidential figures remain withheld. Never imply guaranteed confidentiality or automatic recall of downloads.

title: Track application deadlines and interviews explicitly
basis: SOURCE only follow-up date/status/notes today
problem: An application closing date, follow-up and interview time do not have distinct structured fields. Urgency lives in notes or another system.
action: Add separately labelled deadline, follow-up and interview fields with source, timezone and unknown states. Give a due-soon view and an explicit calendar export option.
acceptance: Two roles with different deadlines are ordered correctly across Dubai/UTC boundaries. An unknown date remains unknown; opening a vacancy or preparing a packet never changes status to applied.

title: Create a useful return habit
effort: 3–5 engineering days plus integration access, estimate
basis: SOURCE manual trigger; native Site has no schedules
problem: Users have to remember to return and trigger another run. There is no configured daily schedule and no independently demonstrated external reminders.
action: Add opt-in, bounded scheduling or discreet calendar reminders after useful sources and recovery are available. Show last successful check, partial coverage and next action; retain the shared usage ceiling.
acceptance: A due reminder occurs only with permission, can be disabled, and respects timezone and budget. A source or inbox failure never appears as 'nothing to do'. This audit does not authorize creating a schedule or sending reminders.

title: Give blocked states task-specific help
basis: LIVE Help covers guest check; SOURCE loop recovery states
problem: Public help explains the six-step check but not claim confirmation, held packets, resume, missing integrations or the multiple workspaces.
action: Add short explanations and a next action at each blocked state, with a working escalation route. Keep operator-only setup details out of customer tasks.
acceptance: An unfamiliar tester can recover from one-page overflow, missing claim context, failed worker dispatch and unavailable search without developer assistance or lost inputs.

title: Let applicants prioritize role directions
basis: SOURCE pooled-title overlap and default sorting
problem: The shortlist does not express a user's preference between consulting, finance or a transition direction, and basic relevance scores cannot decide where scarce application time is best spent.
action: Provide user-set priorities and a compact comparison: role direction, evidence strengths, unresolved conditions, deadline and preparation effort. Show the reason for each suggestion.
acceptance: The same career record produces distinct, defensible emphasis for two directions. Scores remain heuristics; they never become eligibility decisions, ATS scores or interview probabilities.

title: Make a supervised coach review easy
effort: 2–4 engineering days for export workflow, estimate
basis: Coach/adviser use-case inference; current evidence exports
evidence: coach.md; PilotLanding.tsx; CV evidence report export
problem: A coach can recommend the tool and review exported documents, but there is no explicit safe supervised-review workflow or consistent student-oriented pilot packet.
action: Offer a redacted CV/evidence review packet, a short reviewer checklist and a student example. Keep applicant ownership and final approval clear; collaboration access would require a separate consented design.
acceptance: A coach can inspect sources and record suggested changes from a redacted fictional packet without client account credentials. Nothing is sent or shared automatically. Do not present missing enterprise administration as a broken consumer feature.

title: Help applicants defend their story
basis: SOURCE drafts present, recruiter brief absent
problem: The current output emphasizes documents and unsent messages, with limited support for a recruiter conversation or explaining a career transition.
action: Add an optional source-backed brief: why this direction, two contribution stories, open questions and projected-versus-measured reminders. Keep missing evidence visible.
acceptance: Every asserted story links to cleared source facts. The applicant can correct it, and gaps are prompts rather than invented achievements or claims of interview readiness.

title: Explain beta limits in one place
basis: LIVE pricing; SOURCE differing usage units
problem: Free guest checks, one legacy saved pack, three loop runs/day and five packets/run are different units. The planned pass does not explain which future benefits it covers.
action: Publish a plain-language beta access table with current limits and available capabilities. Keep the beta free and payment unavailable under the owner's present constraints; commercial hypotheses belong in research.
acceptance: A first-time applicant can explain current check/pack/run limits without contacting support. No unavailable paid feature is required to complete the advertised free task.

title: Measure activation and repeat usefulness
effort: 2–3 engineering days plus pilot observation, estimate
basis: NOT VERIFIED current retention/conversion/time saving
problem: No measured activation funnel, retention cohort, time saved or willingness-to-pay evidence was supplied or established. Readiness scores cannot substitute for this.
action: Use consented, minimal operational events and observed pilot tasks: check started, evidence reviewed, approved export, first reusable packet and day-seven return. Exclude CV text, vacancy content and email addresses from analytics.
acceptance: Publish counts with denominators, task times and reasons for abandonment. Observe all three target audiences. Targets are prospective and cannot be advertised as achieved outcomes.

title: Reduce unnecessary packet rebuilding safely
basis: SOURCE-only coordinator finding; live consequence not retested
problem: A changed input currently revokes every packet for the account, including when adding a separate vacancy. This is conservative protection but can force unrelated approved work through another run.
action: Investigate dependency-scoped revocation using actual profile, claims and vacancy hashes. Preserve the already fixed withdrawal protection across applied/interview history.
acceptance: Adding vacancy B preserves unaffected packet A only when its complete dependencies and disclosure policy remain unchanged. Withdrawing or correcting a used claim blocks every affected fresh export, including after interview. Verify this in fixtures before weakening any guard.

title: Make mobile evidence review manageable
basis: LIVE mobile measured long review page
problem: A short vacancy produces a very long evidence page, with the primary next action far below the viewport. Repeated labels and manual-review guidance increase effort.
action: Show a compact summary with expandable source comparisons, a clear review count and an accessible persistent next action. Keep unresolved conditions prominent rather than hiding them.
acceptance: At 320/390px and 200% zoom, a user reaches every finding and the next action without horizontal overflow or excessive repeated scrolling. Keyboard focus, labels and approval gates continue to work.
